description: This PHP source file defines the TimesheetItemModel class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API, representing a model for timesheet items with serialization and normalization capabilities. It maps entity data to API response format, including properties like id, date, comment, project, and activity.

classes.name: TimesheetItemModel
classes.description: A model class representing a timesheet item, implementing normalization and serialization traits, with properties mapped from a TimesheetItem entity for API responses.
